negative_reviews.author: erin
negative_reviews.text: although the ramen was a big portion, it was blander than expected, and i received 1 piece of pak choi😢. the staff are very efficient and the food came out quickly, but i wouldn't say this would be my go-to ramen spot. perhaps the other menu items are better, which may mean this review is not representative, but i wouldn't spend more than £5 for the ramen.

negative_reviews.author: A10 Beats
negative_reviews.text: Probably the worst resteraunt in Manchester honestly. I waited (no joke) 20 minuets to be seated. Not once did someone come over to say anything to me. When I was seated. No apology. Nothing. It then took them 10+ minuets to come over and take a drinks order. Me and my partner decided to leave before we had even ordered drinks. The WORST most infuriating place in Manchester. AVOID at all costs.

negative_reviews.author: Hassan Al-Ghawi
negative_reviews.text: Average food. Ordered steak tataki ramen and it could use more flavor and spice. Sushi makis were average.
